stats.note: entropies in bits per scale, weighted by scale count across matrices (per-matrix models); rms_* in log2 units (octaves); *_mm / conditional entropies carry the Miller-Madow correction

bf16_12.decoder: wire only: 5-bit exponent + 7-bit mantissa (sign and low 3 mantissa bits are always 0)

bf16_10.decoder: 3-bit exponent offset + 7-bit mantissa; one 5-bit add of a per-matrix exponent base

dict_lossless.decoder: per-matrix dictionary of its distinct fp16 values: 1024 x 16 b RAM per lane, loaded from a matrix header

cb8.decoder: per-matrix 256 x 16 b LUT (Lloyd, log domain), loaded from a 512 B matrix header

cb6.decoder: per-matrix 64 x 16 b LUT, 128 B header

cb4.decoder: per-matrix 16 x 16 b LUT, 32 B header

cb3.decoder: per-matrix 8 x 16 b LUT, 16 B header

cb2.decoder: per-matrix 4 x 16 b LUT, 8 B header

u8.decoder: uniform log levels: per-matrix 256 x 16 b LUT (or base + k*step into a mantissa ROM)

u6.decoder: uniform log levels: per-matrix 64 x 16 b LUT

u4.decoder: uniform log levels: per-matrix 16 x 16 b LUT

sep0.decoder: rank-1: 16-bit log code per row + 8-bit log code per group column (G-entry table per matrix); one add, 64-entry mantissa ROM, exponent = high bits

sep1.decoder: sep0 + 1-bit residual: second add of a 2-entry offset table

sep2.decoder: sep0 + 2-bit residual: second add of a 4-entry offset table

sep3.decoder: sep0 + 3-bit residual: second add of an 8-entry offset table

sep4.decoder: sep0 + 4-bit residual: second add of a 16-entry offset table

row_only.decoder: one 16-bit log code per row, mantissa ROM

matrix_const.decoder: one scale per matrix (anchor: how much do the scales matter at all)

g256.decoder: none: one fp16 scale held for 2 sign beats

g512.decoder: none: one fp16 scale held for 4 sign beats

g1024.decoder: none: one fp16 scale held for 8 sign beats

g256_cb8.decoder: 256 x 16 b LUT, one code held for 2 sign beats

entropy_H0.decoder: variable-length entropy decoder at ~2.6 scales/cycle (a bound, not a design)

entropy_ctx_left_up.decoder: variable-length entropy decoder at ~2.6 scales/cycle (a bound, not a design)

entropy_sep_resid.decoder: variable-length entropy decoder at ~2.6 scales/cycle (a bound, not a design)

ulog8.decoder: full-range uniform log: code * step + base (two per-matrix constants) into the mantissa ROM, or a per-matrix 256 x 16 b LUT

ulog6.decoder: full-range uniform log: per-matrix 64 x 16 b LUT, 128 B header

ulog5.decoder: full-range uniform log: per-matrix 32 x 16 b LUT, 64 B header

ulog4.decoder: full-range uniform log: per-matrix 16 x 16 b LUT, 32 B header

ulog3.decoder: full-range uniform log: per-matrix 8 x 16 b LUT, 16 B header

cmp4.decoder: companded full-range levels (density^0.15): per-matrix 16 x 16 b LUT, 32 B header

cmp3.decoder: companded full-range levels: per-matrix 8 x 16 b LUT, 16 B header

sepu4.decoder: sep0 + 4-bit full-range uniform residual (16-entry offset table)

sepu3.decoder: sep0 + 3-bit full-range uniform residual (8-entry offset table)

sepu2.decoder: sep0 + 2-bit full-range uniform residual (4-entry offset table)

sepc3.decoder: sep0 + 3-bit companded full-range residual (8-entry offset table)

sepc2.decoder: sep0 + 2-bit companded full-range residual (4-entry offset table)

bfp4.decoder: as bfp3 with 4-bit codes (a header + 32 codes no longer fit one beat)

bfp3.decoder: block floating point: one scale beat per 32 sign beats = 16-bit header (10-bit top log code, 3-bit shift) + 32 x 3-bit codes; per group one shift, one 10-bit subtract, 64-entry mantissa ROM; no per-matrix tables

bfp2.decoder: as bfp3 with 2-bit codes (80 bits per 32 groups)

recommendation.rule: rule A: |dNLL| < 2 SE and < 0.01 nats on the R1c set (1,020 tokens). 'confirmed' = rule A and, pooled over the R1c set and the second set, dNLL + 2 SE < 0.01 nats (non-inferiority at 0.01). 'safe' = confirmed and top-1 agreement >= 0.99 on both sets (the R1c bar). Ties in bytes (0.1 MB) go to the higher top-1.
